guarantees.claim: When op equals AES_ENC, ctrl_wd.operation is assigned AES_ENC.
When op equals AES_DEC, ctrl_wd.operation is assigned AES_DEC.
For any value of op not matching AES_ENC or AES_DEC, ctrl_wd.operation is assigned AES_ENC.
guarantees.cond: op not equal to AES_ENC or AES_DEC

uncertain_points.claim: Unsupported op values map to AES_ENC; it is unclear whether encryption is the safe fallback in all contexts (e.g., when decryption is intended).
uncertain_points.cond: op takes an illegal or unexpected value
uncertain_points.risk: Could cause unintended encryption of data meant to be decrypted, potentially leading to confidentiality loss or denial of service.
